title: Make the retry helper safe for POST
acceptanceCriteria: Every attempt of one `POST` carries the same `idempotency-key`, made once with `newKey()`
A `PATCH` gets a key too; `GET`, `HEAD`, `OPTIONS`, `PUT` and `DELETE` are retried without one
A key the caller already set is kept, not replaced
Only a dropped connection, `408`, `429`, `502`, `503` and `504` are retried; any other status is returned after one attempt
A numeric `retry-after` (seconds) sets the wait; otherwise the wait is `baseDelayMs`, then double each time
After `maxAttempts`, the last response is returned or the last network error is rethrown
